name: ffmpeg-h26x
description: ffmpeg H.261, H.263 and Sorenson H.263 decoder
help: This is a reduced version of ffmpeg carrying the H.261, H.263 and Sorenson H.263 (FLV1) decoders only: the ITU-T video recommendations that predate MPEG-4 AVC, and the variant of H.263 that Flash Video shipped with.
